instruction: Fix `chunk` in `seqops/transforms.py` so the final partial chunk is included in the result. It currently only emits full-size chunks, dropping the trailing remainder when `len(items)` is not a multiple of `size`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops/transforms.py b/seqops/transforms.py
--- a/seqops/transforms.py
+++ b/seqops/transforms.py
@@ -35,7 +35,7 @@
     """
     if size <= 0:
         raise ValueError("size must be a positive integer")
-    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items) - size + 1, size)]
+    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]
